title: Can Dee Dee Help Palmer

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Well what are you hanging around like a bad smell for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well what are you hanging around like a bad smell for?

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Didn’t you hear, those were outlawed years ago, along with cutting slack and throwing bones. CorpSec don’t like favors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Didn’t you hear, those were outlawed years ago, along with cutting slack and throwing bones. CorpSec don’t like favors.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Go on then, cough it up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go on then, cough it up.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: You got a duckling and think old DeeDee’s a mother hen? A sucker with room for all the strays in the city?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got a duckling and think old DeeDee’s a mother hen? A sucker with room for all the strays in the city?

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: This friend of yours... what did they do? Piss off the ‘Sec? Murder someone?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This friend of yours... what did they do? Piss off the ‘Sec? Murder someone?

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Try again, kiddie. You’re the one asking for heaven and earth here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Try again, kiddie. You’re the one asking for heaven and earth here.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Palmer Vesh? You want that space harpy to turn hopper? That’s the dumbest thing I ever heard!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Palmer Vesh? You want that space harpy to turn hopper? That’s the dumbest thing I ever heard!

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Look, if Vesh really is in the LUZ, then the ‘Sec are going to tear this place apart to find her. That means a whole lotta collateral damage.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, if Vesh really is in the LUZ, then the ‘Sec are going to tear this place apart to find her. That means a whole lotta collateral damage.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Must have “sucker” tatooed across my forehead. I never turned a stray away before, and I ain’t going to start now, pirate or not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Must have “sucker” tatooed across my forehead. I never turned a stray away before, and I ain’t going to start now, pirate or not.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: You‘ve used up a favor here, kid. Remember that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You‘ve used up a favor here, kid. Remember that.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: You think I have “sucker” tattooed across my forehead? I’m retired, and I’m sure as shit not risking what I got for someone like Vesh.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think I have “sucker” tattooed across my forehead? I’m retired, and I’m sure as shit not risking what I got for someone like Vesh.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Not my problem. She really wants out of the city, she'll have to sail her ass outta here. Now, leave me and mine alone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not my problem. She really wants out of the city, she'll have to sail her ass outta here. Now, leave me and mine alone.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Tell Vesh to be at the western end of MetroHub right before curfew. No bags, no packs. Just her. Got that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell Vesh to be at the western end of MetroHub right before curfew. No bags, no packs. Just her. Got that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need a favor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need a favor.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don’t care what CorpSec like. That’s why I’m here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t care what CorpSec like. That’s why I’m here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don’t care what CorpSec like. That’s why I’m here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don’t care what CorpSec like. That’s why I’m here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know someone who needs to get out of the LUZ.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know someone who needs to get out of the LUZ.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I know someone who needs to get out of the LUZ.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I know someone who needs to get out of the LUZ.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I think you’re kind enough to help people when they’re in trouble.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I think you’re kind enough to help people when they’re in trouble.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, I think you’re kind enough to help people when they’re in trouble.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, I think you’re kind enough to help people when they’re in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I think your enemy's enemy is your friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I think your enemy's enemy is your friend.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, I think your enemy's enemy is your friend.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, I think your enemy's enemy is your friend.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Her name’s Palmer Vesh and she’s a wanted criminal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Her name’s Palmer Vesh and she’s a wanted criminal.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Her name’s Palmer Vesh and she’s a wanted criminal.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Her name’s Palmer Vesh and she’s a wanted criminal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can’t tell you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can’t tell you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Her name's Palmer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Her name's Palmer.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you won’t help her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you won’t help her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know. That’s why I came to you. You’ve got a heart.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know. That’s why I came to you. You’ve got a heart.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I know. That’s why I came to you. You’ve got a heart.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I know. That’s why I came to you. You’ve got a heart.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That’s why I came to you. You’re tough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That’s why I came to you. You’re tough.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That’s why I came to you. You’re tough.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That’s why I came to you. You’re tough.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I’ve got it. Thanks DeeDee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’ve got it. Thanks DeeDee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But she'll be caught...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But she'll be caught...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What if I'm an outlaw?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What if I'm an outlaw?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?
